baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated يَسْتَوِى and the threefold أَصْحَابُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah compares not isolated persons but two forms of durable affiliation. Repetition makes company the unit placed on the balance, and the negation refuses their exchangeability.

activation_trace.role: Equality and equivalence between two things supply the balance that the negation explicitly refuses.
Companionship and sustained attachment make each side a relational company rather than a head count.

changed_reading.before: Two sets assigned to different destinations are unequal.
changed_reading.after: Two sustained affiliations are nonexchangeable; what is weighed is the company a person remains with.

baseline_models.mechanism: Fire is a kindled, moving medium while garden is a tree-covered enclosure. The repeated companionship construction lets each environment function as an abiding ecology that accompanies and forms its people.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire and its agitated illumination provide the active medium of one company.
A garden enclosed by covering trees provides the inhabited medium of the other company.
Making one thing accompany another supplies the functional bond between each environment and its people.

changed_reading.before: Fire and garden are two locations occupied by two groups.
changed_reading.after: Fire and garden are contrasting companion-environments whose motion or shelter becomes inseparable from their people.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ٱلْجَنَّةِ followed by هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden can image an effective shield, while الفوز joins escape from harm to attainment of good. The emphatic identification therefore renders winning as preserved arrival under cover, not merely possession of a prize.

activation_trace.role: The protective shield supplies garden as cover that actually wards off harm.
Escape from evil together with gaining good defines the result of entering that cover.

changed_reading.before: The winners are those who receive the better reward.
changed_reading.after: The winners are those brought safely into an efficacious shelter where rescue and attained good coincide.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claimed preventing strength, encircling fortresses, self-produced ruin, and later walls around scattered hearts form a failed shelter-system. Against it, the focus garden-as-shield becomes protection that preserves from within rather than an impressive shell.

activation_trace.role: The garden's shield image is the focus anchor tested against the context's defensive structures.
Strength thought to protect against penetration supplies the claim of effective defense.
Preservation inside an encircling fortress gives that defensive claim a material shell.
Ruination of built habitation reverses the fortress image and exposes protection that cannot preserve itself.
Raised walls repeat external enclosure while the verse locates division behind it.

structural_cues: 59:2 moves from presumed fortress-protection to houses ruined by their own occupants, and 59:14 places scattered hearts behind fortifications and walls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies defenses that look preventing yet fail from within; I infer that they are a counterfeit of the focus garden's protective cover. A live alternative is that these scenes concern military defenses only and do not characterize garden-protection.

changed_reading.before: Garden is a safe enclosure opposed to fire.
changed_reading.after: Garden is the true shelter distinguished from walls and fortresses whose enclosed community can collapse from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: A palm may be severed or remain upright on its roots. This material sequence activates the focus garden as a living, rooted stand whose covering power depends on continuing organic attachment, not decorative scenery.

activation_trace.role: Dense, lengthening, interlaced vegetation supplies garden as active growth rather than static landscape.
Severance supplies the destructive alternative to continuing rooted attachment.
The palm itself supplies the concrete living material from which a covered garden is formed.
Bodily uprightness gives the preserved palm its continuing stance.
Root and foundation make that stance a consequence of deep attachment.

structural_cues: 59:5 balances cutting a palm against leaving it standing on its roots in one compact alternative construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies living palms, cutting, uprightness, and roots; I infer that this sequence materializes the focus garden's shelter as maintained rooted life. Alternatively it may remain a local image of wartime cultivation with no direct bearing on 59:20.

changed_reading.before: Garden is a finished destination offering cover.
changed_reading.after: Garden is a rooted living enclosure: its shelter images sustained attachment and growth that survive the possibility of severance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context blocks wealth from circulating within a closed rich circuit, then names preferring others and being guarded from acquisitive withholding before declaring such people flourishing. This makes focus الفوز a social victory over possessive closure as well as personal rescue.

activation_trace.role: Attaining good while escaping harm is the focus result whose social mechanism the context specifies.
Movement of a turn or asset among hands supplies the circulation that must not close around the wealthy.
Choosing another in preference to oneself supplies the counter-movement to closed possession.
Withholding joined to greed identifies the internal blockage from which rescue is needed.
Winning and lasting provide the lexical bridge from that anti-hoarding practice to the focus declaration of winners.

structural_cues: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ in 59:9 anticipates the emphatic هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ of 59:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies redistribution, self-preference reversed, greed warded off, and an emphatic flourishing verdict; I infer that these form one social route into focus الفوز. Alternatively the two success terms may remain parallel rewards without specifying each other's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Winning is an individual's acquisition of safety and good.
changed_reading.after: Winning includes release from the possessive self into a company where good circulates and another can be preferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reckoning a population to be gathered is contradicted by its dispersed hearts. The contrast sharpens focus أَصْحَابُ: a visible aggregate is not yet a company; durable companionship requires an interior relation that holds.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship supplies the stronger form of togetherness against which apparent aggregation is tested.
Supposition supplies the observer's mistaken classification of the group.
Joining dispersed parts into a collected whole supplies the visible togetherness being claimed.
Dispersion and scattering disclose the inward relation that defeats the appearance of a whole.

structural_cues: تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ directly opposes perceived totality to inward dispersion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an apparent gathering and scattered hearts; I infer that interior coherence is what converts aggregation into the focus ayah's companionship. Alternatively أَصْحَابُ may remain only a conventional class label without implying mutual coherence.

changed_reading.before: Companions of fire and garden are externally identifiable groups.
changed_reading.after: The label 'companions' probes the relation holding a group together; outward collectivity can conceal the absence of true company.

context_deltas.mechanism: A speaker's declaration of separation is immediately reversed by the pair's lasting adhesion in fire. The focus 'companions of fire' can therefore name consequence-companionship: an alliance disowned in speech but rebound as a shared abiding outcome.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and lasting association provide the relation unexpectedly restored after disavowal.
The kindled fire is the common medium in which the severed pair becomes a company of consequence.
Disassociation and distance supply the attempted termination of companionship.
Clinging, settling, and sustained attachment reverse that termination into an abiding shared condition.

structural_cues: The singular disavowal in 59:16 gives way to the repeated dual forms عَٰقِبَتَهُمَآ, أَنَّهُمَا, and خَٰلِدَيْنِ in 59:17 immediately before the plural أَصْحَابُ of 59:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal separation followed by dual permanence in fire; I infer that shared consequence reconstitutes the failed alliance as companionship. Alternatively the dual may mark only co-punishment, not a renewed social relation.

changed_reading.before: Companions of fire are people who positively belong to the same destination.
changed_reading.after: They may also be people whose disowned alliance rebounds into an inseparable shared consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reflexive inspection, what has been advanced, and intentional action turn the focus comparison into an audit of trajectories. The two companies do not fail to equal one another arbitrarily; their forwarded acts produce unlike arrivals.

activation_trace.role: Equality and balancing supply the focus verdict whose evaluative procedure the preceding verse activates.
Matching like against like until they become equal supplies an unusually direct branch-image for comparative audit.
Advancing forward supplies the trajectory whose result is later placed in comparison.
Intended action identifies what generates the divergent trajectories rather than leaving them as static labels.

structural_cues: 59:18 commands one self to inspect what it advanced for tomorrow only two ayat before the categorical لَا يَسْتَوِى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, prior advancement, and intended action; I infer an audit-arrow from those acts to the focus non-equivalence. Alternatively 59:18 may urge preparation without supplying a formal weighing procedure.

changed_reading.before: The two companies are statically declared unequal.
changed_reading.after: Their non-equivalence is the disclosed result of self-inspected, intentionally forwarded trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: Even a raised solid mass is imagined lowering and splitting under reception. Coming directly after the focus verdict, this makes non-equivalence readable as differential responsiveness rather than an unchangeable difference of substance.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence is the focus relation recast as an outcome of unlike response.
A raised solid mass supplies the strongest apparent case of fixed resistance.
Lowering and submission supply the first transformation of that resistant mass.
A crack opening through something solid supplies the transformation's visible completion.

structural_cues: The counterfactual mountain image follows 59:20 immediately and moves from reception to lowering and fracture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a solid mountain transformed by reception; I infer that response under disclosure can generate the focus distinction between companies. Alternatively the mountain is a separate illustration of gravity, not a mechanism for 59:20.

changed_reading.before: Fire-company and garden-company differ as fixed classes.
changed_reading.after: Their inequality can register unlike responsiveness: what is received either reorganizes the self or leaves it aligned with another company.

context_deltas.mechanism: Safety from defect, watchful care, and repair of fracture cluster after the focus. They thicken garden-as-shield and الفوز-as-rescue into preserved wholeness: the winning condition is being kept, watched, and restored rather than dominating others.

activation_trace.role: The protective shield gives the focus garden a preserving function.
Rescue from harm and attainment of good identify preservation as genuine winning.
Safety and freedom from defects supply the condition preserved by the garden-shield.
Witnessing care and guardianship supply the active maintenance of that safety.
Repairing breakage and deficiency supplies restoration where preservation has been breached.

structural_cues: The post-focus name sequence places ٱلسَّلَٰمُ, ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ, and ٱلْجَبَّارُ in one compact predicative series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies safety, guardianship, and repair in a single sequence; I infer that they jointly describe how the focus garden-shield yields rescue. Alternatively the names may resist conversion into a single protective mechanism, especially where ج ب ر activates coercive rather than reparative force.

changed_reading.before: The garden company's victory is superiority over the fire company.
changed_reading.after: Its victory is protected wholeness: safety is maintained by care and restored where broken.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ٱلنَّارِ most directly names kindled fire, but the focus inventory also carries enmity flaring among people, and the context supplies concealed rancor plus severe intra-group force. It remains anchored in ن و ر and repeated companionship; downstream prose should present it as a relational overlay on fire, not a replacement for the primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَصْحَابُ ٱلنَّارِ, with the ن و ر branch of hostility occurring among a group.

activation_trace.role: Enmity flaring among people permits fire to carry a social-conflagration image.
Sustained association makes that hostility a medium binding its own company.
Latent rancor in the chest supplies concealed fuel for the relational fire.
Severe overpowering force within the group supplies the hostility's outward burn.

changed_reading.before: Companions of fire are occupants of a burning destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are also a company constituted by the rancor and internal violence that already burn among them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The polarity is surprising because familiar imagery can make garden visibly bright and fire merely punitive, whereas these branches align fire with disclosure and garden with concealment. It remains anchored in the focus roots and the adjacent unseen/witnessed pair; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial-epistemic activation, not claim that garden simply equals the unseen.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلنَّارِ and ٱلْجَنَّةِ as ن و ر visibility versus ج ن ن covering.

activation_trace.role: Light and illumination let fire function as exposure rather than mere darkness.
Covering from sensory access lets garden function as protected concealment.
Being hidden from eyes supplies the concealed pole of the adjacent contrast.
Presence with witnessing supplies the manifest pole against which concealment is read.

changed_reading.before: Fire and garden contrast punishment with reward.
changed_reading.after: They can additionally contrast exposed, agitated manifestation with sheltered, covered life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because فوز normally resolves as unambiguous success, while the packet's مفازة branch holds rescue and waterless peril together. It remains directly anchored in ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ; downstream prose should describe a lexical tension in the route to victory, not redefine success as destruction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ through the ف و ز branch of the مفازة poised between rescue and lethal wasteland.

activation_trace.role: The wilderness named both as escape and as waterless danger turns winning into successful passage through a zone that could destroy.

changed_reading.before: Winners are those already in possession of the good endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, winners are those who make it through a perilous passage in which rescue is meaningful precisely because ruin remained possible.

strongest_changes: The garden's cover is distinguished from counterfeit fortresses and walls that fail from within.
The success formula is socially specified by circulation, preference for others, and release from acquisitive withholding.
Apparent gathering with scattered hearts makes true companionship an interior coherence rather than a visible aggregate.
Self-inspection of intentional acts turns لَا يَسْتَوِى into an audit of divergent trajectories.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah's terse binary opened into mechanisms of shelter, social circulation, inward group formation, and trajectory-audit while preserving stranger root-level activations: fire as intra-group enmity, garden as protected concealment, and الفوز as passage through peril.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the failed fortifications are intended as a direct foil to the garden's shield branch or only provide a local military contrast.
Whether the mountain's transformation explains the two companies through responsiveness or begins an independent admonitory image.
Whether reparative ج ب ر should be carried beside the more immediate coercive force of ٱلْجَبَّارُ in 59:23.
Whether the social-enmity and exposure/concealment readings should remain commentary-level overlays rather than rendered interpretations.
